storyCards.headline: Selling The Drama: The Performance That Defined It
storyCards.fact:
Live's "Selling The Drama" reached #43 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Selling the Drama" is the first single from Live's 1994 album, Throwing Copper.

The song peaked at #43 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Selling The Drama was released in 1994.
